title: Full Standalone Isometric Game
creator: Agent Buildprint
summary: Full original isometric game workflow: one approved contract, mobile-first UX, source-based v2 CLI routing and evidence-bound acceptance. The npm registry currently exposes only 0.0.17, which lacks v2.
promise: Guides the entire agreed game without shrinking it to calibration or copying framework demos.
includes: Kernel packet and six full-game loops
One PROJECT_CONTRACT.md outline with preserved approvals
Pinned upstream skill routing and v3 visual acceptance reuse
Technique-driven optional providers and capability gaps
Local package manifest and scaffold-first bootstrap instructions
risks: The npm registry currently exposes only agent-buildprint@0.0.17, which lacks v2. The supported v2 route uses one fresh matching source checkout for its CLI and local packet and records that checkout's HEAD.
Framework is not on npm; pinned local build:package includes prerequisite checks that run with authorized implementation unless explicitly restricted.
Bria and Media4Agents routes require separately verified authorized integrations and budget approval.
Actual game captures and genuine review capability remain required; unavailable evidence is unverified, not accepted.
Independent raster measurement, host event-to-render latency and semantic gait/legal-motion verification remain upstream/host work; the CLI checks recorded claims, not pixels.
checks: Source runtime and packaged routing checks are bounded CLI verification, not game acceptance
Authorized implementation runs routine verification unless explicitly restricted
Do not claim visual, motion or gameplay acceptance from structural checks
